newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DSM shares slump 7.6 pct after results.
newsitem.headline: DSM shares slump 7.6 pct after results.

text.p: Shares in Dutch chemicals group DSM NV languished 17.50 guilders or 7.6 percent lower at 212.50, following its first half results, which came in at the lower end of analysts' forecasts.
Net profit rose 13 percent to 465 million, at the lower end of forecasts which ranged between 452 and 544 million.

"I thought the results were a little disappointing, especially the developments in industrial and fine chemicals," said Nils van Elzelingen of NIB Securities. "In general we think the outlook for DSM in the next two years is not so good and our recommendation remains at Underperformer."

DSM shares had soared from 195 guilders at the beginning of July to 235 guilders at the close on Tuesday, meeting demand ahead of the results and on a perception cyclical shares had underperformed the overall market.

DSM had up until Tuesday's closing risen 37 percent since the beginning of the year, when the shares stood at 168 guilders each. The AEX index of 25 leading Dutch shares had risen 50 percent over the same period.
